connectorUiConfig.title: VirtualMetric DataStream - Sentinel Standard (Push)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [VirtualMetric DataStream](https://docs.virtualmetric.com/) Push connector Pushes CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, Event, Syslog, and WindowsEvent telemetry. Authentication, the Data Collection Endpoint, the Data Collection Rule, and required role assignments are provisioned automatically when you click Deploy. After deployment the connection details below are populated and can be copied into your DataStream agent configuration.

| where DeviceVendor == 'VirtualMetric' or DeviceProduct has 'DataStream')

| extend SourceTable = 'SecurityEvent'
| where DeviceVendor == 'VirtualMetric' or DeviceProduct has 'DataStream')
| union (Event
| extend SourceTable = 'Event'
| where DeviceVendor == 'VirtualMetric' or DeviceProduct has 'DataStream')
| union (Syslog

| where DeviceVendor == 'VirtualMetric' or DeviceProduct has 'DataStream')

customs.name: VirtualMetric DataStream Agent
customs.description: A running [VirtualMetric DataStream](https://docs.virtualmetric.com/) agent is required to collect, normalize, and push events to the Microsoft Sentinel Logs Ingestion API.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Deploy connector resources
instructionSteps.description: This connector enables the VirtualMetric DataStream agent to push events directly to Microsoft Sentinel via the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. No manual app registration or DCR setup is required.

parameters.content:
Clicking **Deploy** will create:
- A Data Collection Rule (DCR) with 5 stream(s) routing to the built-in Microsoft Sentinel tables (CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, Event, Syslog, WindowsEvent)
- A Data Collection Endpoint (DCE)
- A Microsoft Entra application with OAuth client credentials
- The Monitoring Metrics Publisher role assignment for that application on the DCR

No custom tables are created — events land in the built-in tables, so existing analytics rules, workbooks, and parsers continue to work unchanged.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Configure the VirtualMetric DataStream agent
instructionSteps.description: After the deployment completes, copy the values below into your VirtualMetric DataStream agent configuration. The DataStream agent uses these to authenticate with Microsoft Entra and push events to the Data Collection Endpoint.

parameters.label: Application (Client) ID
parameters.placeholder: Deploy connector resources to populate this value

parameters.label: Client Secret (only shown once)
parameters.placeholder: Deploy connector resources to populate this value

parameters.label: Data Collection Endpoint Logs Ingestion URI
parameters.placeholder: Deploy connector resources to populate this value

parameters.label: Data Collection Rule Immutable ID
parameters.placeholder: Deploy connector resources to populate this value

parameters.content:
Configure these stream names in the VirtualMetric DataStream agent so each event type is routed to the matching table:

- `Custom-CommonSecurityLog`
- `Custom-SecurityEvent`
- `Custom-Event`
- `Custom-Syslog`
- `Custom-WindowsEvent`

instructionSteps.title: 3. Verify ingestion
instructionSteps.description: After enabling the integration in the VirtualMetric DataStream agent, allow 5-10 minutes for the first events to appear, then run the sample queries above. If no data appears, verify the DataStream agent has reachability to the Data Collection Endpoint and that the Entra application credentials match.
